name: Default
shortDescription: Development SMTP server that catches every message sent to it and shows the HTML, plain text, source and attachments in a web UI with a JSON API.

alerts.message: MailCatcher has no login: anyone who can reach the domain can read and delete caught mail. Add a credential under Settings -> Access to put the app behind HTTP basic auth.

Only the web UI is published. The SMTP server is reachable only from apps in the same environment at mailcatcher:1025, with no authentication and no TLS. Messages are kept in memory and are lost on restart.
